page.overview:
Who is Foxy Pirates?

The Foxy Pirates are a group of pirates led by Foxy the Silver Fox. A majority of the crew was composed people won through Davy Back Fights.

Before meeting the Straw Hat Pirates, the crew was composed of 500 members, according to the anime. However, sometime after the Straw Hats defeated them, the crew fell on hard times and was apparently reduced to just three members.

They are the main antagonist group in the Long Ring Long Land Arc. They also act as an antagonist group in the Foxy's Return and Spa Island filler Arcs.

Foxy's original flag was a standard Jolly Roger with fox ears and Foxy's unique nose, with the word 'FOXY' written on it. This was taken by Monkey D. Luffy as a prize for winning the Davy Back Fight.
